kurzbeschreibung: The Schnitzschule Elbigenalp in the Lechtal is Austria's oldest technical school for wood carving and presents outstanding woodcraft artistry.
beschreibung:
The Artisanal Heart of the Tyrolean Lechtal

The municipality of Elbigenalp is considered the cultural center of the Lechtal and the cradle of traditional wood carving. The local Fachschule für Kunsthandwerk was established back in 1851 and enjoys high international prestige for training young sculptors and painters.

Fascinating Sculptural Art and Gallery

In the exhibition rooms and workshops, visitors admire intricate Madonna figures, portraits, modern wood sculptures, and sacred woodcarvings. The intimate fusion of Alpine tradition and contemporary formal expression makes a visit a remarkable artistic experience.
